item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Your day's got structure around it — movement, quiet moments, check-ins with yourself. Medication works the same way meditation and walks do: consistency, not intensity. Don't let a busy schedule become the excuse to skip a dose or push it late. Take it on time, same as everything else you've built in today. Action: take your medication now, before you move to the next thing on your list.
